intro_paragraphs: When a walk-in cooler stops holding temperature, the clock starts ticking on food safety and inventory loss. Frost Fire Heating and Cooling provides same-day walk-in cooler repair in Raleigh, NC and across the Triangle — including Durham, Clayton, Garner, Cary, and nearby cities. We diagnose compressor, evaporator, condenser, refrigerant, and door-seal failures quickly so you can protect product and reopen service.

Unlike a general residential HVAC call, commercial cooler repair is about urgency and food-code compliance. Our technicians carry common commercial refrigeration parts, understand restaurant operating hours, and work to restore safe holding temperatures as fast as possible. We also repair walk-in freezers and related make-line equipment when the whole cold chain is affected.
Searching for walk in cooler repair Raleigh NC or restaurant walk in cooler repair? Call (919) 230-4439. We answer 24/7 — and we charge the same price on Sundays as weekdays.
cards_h2: Common Walk-In Cooler Failures We Fix
cards_h2_html: Common Walk-In Cooler Failures We Fix

cards.title: Compressor & Condensing Unit Issues
cards.body: Short cycling, hard starts, overheating, or a unit that runs constantly without pulling down temperature.

cards.title: Evaporator Coil & Fan Problems
cards.body: Iced coils, weak airflow, noisy evaporator fans, and uneven temperatures from front to back of the box.

cards.title: Refrigerant Leaks
cards.body: Low charge, oil stains, hissing, or gradual warm-up. We locate leaks, repair, and recharge to manufacturer specs.

cards.title: Door Seals, Latches & Heaters
cards.body: Torn gaskets, doors that won't seal, and failed door heaters that cause ice buildup and energy waste.

cards.title: Controls & Thermostats
cards.body: Failed controllers, bad sensors, and defrost timers that leave the box too warm or locked in defrost.

cards.title: Emergency After-Hours Failures
cards.body: Nights, weekends, and holidays — we treat cooler emergencies as priority commercial calls.

process_h2: How Our Cooler Repair Process Works
process_h2_html: How Our Cooler Repair Process Works

steps.title: Call & Triage
steps.body: Tell us the symptoms, box temperature, and whether food is at risk. We prioritize inventory-threatening failures.

steps.title: On-Site Diagnosis
steps.body: We check pressures, electrical, airflow, seals, and controls — then explain the repair in plain language.

steps.title: Repair & Pull-Down
steps.body: We complete the repair, verify the box is pulling down, and confirm safe holding temperatures before we leave.

steps.title: Prevention Tips
steps.body: We flag door seal wear, dirty condensers, and maintenance needs so the next failure is less likely.
